model.title: Northeast Lobsterman Protection Act of 2026
model.meta: Natural Resources Committee · Rep. Michael Lawler (R-NY)

summary.text: The bill would extend the deadline for the federal government to issue new regulations protecting endangered North Atlantic right whales from fishing gear entanglement, pushing the deadline from 2028 to 2035. It aims to give the lobster and crab fishing industries more time to comply with requirements to use existing or new technologies that reduce the risk of whales becoming tangled in their equipment.
